sources: DART detail search https://dart.fss.or.kr/dsab007/detailSearch.ax (corporationType=P, exact report names)

gaps.reason: Historical KOSPI 200 constituents could not be fetched: kind.krx.co.kr, www/index/open/global.krx.co.kr return 403 (Akamai) to automated reads, data.krx.co.kr constituent data requires a login, and the Wayback Machine was unreachable through the proxy. Universe = current constituents from the en/ko Wikipedia KOSPI 200 tables (fetched Oct 2026); rows therefore omit `index`, and companies that left the index before 2026 (or delisted) are not covered.
Company-website copies not collected; only the DART regulator copy (receipt-number URL from the fetched listing) is linked.

Provisional-results report names on DART carry no fiscal period; period left empty. Only companies that filed 영업(잠정)실적 fair disclosures are covered; where consolidated and separate notices were filed the same day only the consolidated one is kept.

Row date is the DART notice filing date, not the IR session date (which is only inside each notice); notices are not split into earnings calls vs other IR events. Multiple notices filed on the same day by one company are collapsed to one row.
Date is the filing date of 정기주주총회결과 (normally the meeting day). AGM convocation notices not collected.
Bracket-prefixed DART titles ([기재정정], [첨부정정], ...) are skipped; only original filings are kept.
DART search listings give receipt date only; no release time collected.
Current constituents with no matching DART filings in 2010-01..2021-09 (mostly listed or created after Sep 2021, or filings under a predecessor corp code).
